name: NORTHERN PASSAGE
description: An allied freighter is making a short passage off the Norwegian coast. Two Russian surface combatants have entered the approaches, among civilian traffic. Your task is to deliver the freighter, not clear the sea of every opposing ship. There is time to put a Seahawk airborne before the surface forces close. Broken clouds and light drizzle hang over a moderate sea. Real geography and real platform families; the conflict, the deployment and the tactical situation are fiction.

map.anchor_note: World coordinates are nautical miles about this point; one minute of latitude is one mile and longitude is scaled by the cosine of the anchor latitude.
map.chart_note: Natural Earth 1:10m land and bathymetry · local projection · not for navigation

route_validation.note: Turning and the exit radius are measured separately in validation-m31.json.

learning: Reconnaissance, emissions, protecting a moving civilian asset, and finite missile defence
commander_intent: Bring Northern Light into the exit box before 08:45Z. Keep neutral traffic alive; enemy destruction is optional.
first_orders: Northern Light is already following an eight-mile dogleg at 15 knots. The escorts are following her; keep that screen together.

While paused, press Air / F3, select Truxtun and the Seahawk, then Launch. Once airborne, choose Patrol and click two corners near the convoy to repeat a search circuit. Recover early when threats close; right-click water gives a transit order instead.

Click a contact to inspect it without losing your selected ship. Right-click an unknown to investigate it; use the Seahawk so the escorts stay with the convoy. Right-click a classified hostile to attack it: the ship closes to range, chooses the weapon and keeps firing until the contact is destroyed. Shift+right-click a contact for a stated salvo or the full firing board. Automatic defence is on.
setting_note: Original fictional 2027 operation, not a reconstruction of a real conflict or a 1999 order of battle.
force_note: Represented families: Arleigh Burke Flight IIA, Fridtjof Nansen, Project 22350, Project 20380, and MH-60R. The single US helicopter detachment, readiness, magazines, sensor performance, hit probabilities and deployments are representative gameplay assumptions; see DATA_SOURCES.md. The freighter uses the existing generic bulk carrier's 15-knot cap and is under your navigation orders; all merchant names are fictional.

operation_plan.title: 01 / Establish the picture
operation_plan.task: Launch reconnaissance, inspect unknowns and keep the escorts with the freighter. The opposing commander must detect and classify its own targets.

operation_plan.title: 02 / Protect the passage
operation_plan.task: Keep radar coverage and defensive magazines available as the freighter turns north. Use NSM against classified hostile surface contacts if useful; do not chase them away from the convoy.

operation_plan.title: 03 / Deliver the ship
operation_plan.task: Reach the exit within 45 minutes, with no neutral sinking caused by your weapons. Review losses, ammunition and observed events in the debrief.

objectives.text: Deliver Northern Light before 08:45Z without sinking a neutral vessel.

victory.text: Escort Northern Light into the exit box

loss.text: Your force sank a neutral vessel

forces: Your command: Burke IIA destroyer, Nansen frigate, one MH-60R and the escorted freighter. Opposition: Gorshkov frigate and Steregushchiy corvette. Two neutral merchants share the approaches.
